# 1 Enoch Chapter 38 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**38:1** Here begins the First Parable. The time is coming when the righteous community will be revealed, when sinners will face judgment for their sins and be swept from the face of the earth.

**38:2** When the Righteous One appears before the eyes of the chosen — those whose deeds the Lord of Spirits has been weighing — light will shine upon all the righteous and the chosen who live on the earth. But then what? Where will sinners find a home? Where will those who rejected the Lord of Spirits find rest? It would have been better for them if they had never been born.

**38:3** When the Righteous One's hidden purposes are finally unveiled, he will judge the sinners. The wicked will not be able to look into the faces of the holy, because the light of the Lord of Spirits will blaze upon the faces of all who are holy, righteous, and chosen.

**38:4** At that time kings and the powerful will be destroyed, handed over into the power of the righteous and the holy.

**38:5** After that, no one will beg the Lord of Spirits for mercy, for their time will have run out.

**38:6** In those days, gold and silver will be worthless — no one will escape. War will have no weapons; armor will be useless. Bronze, tin, and lead will all be thrown aside and melted away from the face of the earth when the Chosen One stands before the Lord of Spirits.

---

*PNEUMA notes: This chapter sets up the great reversal at the heart of the Parables: the righteous, now marginalized, will be vindicated, while the powerful will face ruin. The uselessness of metals anticipates the dramatic vision of ch. 52, where mountains of metal are melted before the Chosen One.*
